steps.title: Explore
steps.body: Day 1. Self-serve sandbox, full API, no contract. Engineers build against testnets the afternoon they get access.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.body: The due-diligence pack is ready before you ask: SOC 2 and ISO reports, pentests, docs, pre-completed questionnaires.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: A scoped slice in production. One use case, real controls, named solutions engineer. Testnet to mainnet under your policies.

steps.title: Go live
steps.body: Phased, not big-bang. Policies and quorums configured to your org chart; runbooks delivered; rollout staged by volume.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body: Without re-architecture. Add modules, chains, and deployment layers, SaaS to sovereign, on the same unified platform.
